coord_system.description: Game-internal world coordinates.  Higher x = east, higher y = south.  Roughly 30–35 game-units per real-world degree.

anchors._comment: Spot-check anchors useful for runtime calibration of pixels-per-game-unit at a given zoom level.  Pick two visible ports, measure their pixel separation, derive scale.
